title: Earn online with AI faceless videos for beginners
description: AI se ghar baithe online income ka simple, honest tareeka. Educational.
voice: Ghar baithe AI se online kamaana hai? Ek aisa side hustle hai jisme camera ki bhi zaroorat nahi. Isse kehte hain faceless content. Pehle ek topic chuno, jaise facts ya motivation. Phir ChatGPT se chhota script likhwao. Ab ElevenLabs se uss script ki AI voiceover banao, ekdum natural. Free stock clips ke upar voice laga do, captions add karo, aur Short ready. Roz ek video, consistent raho. Shuruaat me kamaai kam hogi, par audience badhte hi yeh asli income ban sakti hai. Yaad rakho, mehnat aur sabr dono chahiye. Aise hi honest AI earning ideas ke liye Paisa Pathshala ko follow karo.
